text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our red-hot summer camp experience
comes to a
close, and it's time to head
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I can hardly believe that summer camp
is
already over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This year's summer camp was truly
enjoyable. I
truly felt that I was living in
the moment... and I
made summer
memories that will last a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, our goal race is fast
approaching.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I assure you that once we return to the
academy,
I'll get myself back into the
racing mindset, so I
shall be counting on
your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the fall G1 races right around the
corner,
Mejiro Ardan and I are making
our final push!
